name: wmc-exact
title: Weighted model counting over a source-reliability encoding

reference.cite: Chavira & Darwiche 2008, On probabilistic inference by weighted model counting
Fierens et al. 2014, Inference and learning in probabilistic logic programs using weighted Boolean formulas

assumptions.text: Each claim is true or false; no degrees.
A link fires with probability r (llr x gives r = 1 - e^-x) independently, except through declared clusters; a firing, un-undercut support link forces its claim true (contradict: false).
Within a cluster of correlation rho, each link copies a shared draw with probability rho, else draws alone; the shared draw is comonotone across members with different reliabilities.
Dependence not declared as a cluster is absent.
Claim priors are base rates, not earlier composed estimates; otherwise a re-run double counts.

cost.typical: exponential in treewidth, not size: milliseconds for forest-like bundles of hundreds of variables

base_rate.description: Prior for a claim with none.

unweighted.description: What to do with an unweighted support/contradict link.
